About the Role (This is an on-site position)


This Senior HR Generalist role will serve as a key resource for employees and leadership, with a primary focus on employee/labor relations and workplace investigations.  This position supervises one HR Generalist and reports directly to the Manager of Human Resources.   • Ability to work with independence, sound judgment, and high attention to detail.
